abstract:
CALVIN - A benchmark for Language-Conditioned Policy Learning for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation Tasks

# CALVIN [ ](https://github.com/psf/black) [ ](https://lgtm.com/projects/g/mees/calvin/context:python) [ ](https://lgtm.com/projects/g/mees/calvin/alerts/) [ ](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT) [ CALVIN - A benchmark for Language-Conditioned Policy Learning for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation Tasks ](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2112.03227.pdf) [Oier Mees](https://www.oiermees.com/), [Lukas Hermann](https://lukashermann.github.io/), [Erick Rosete](https://www.erickrosete.com/), [Wolfram Burgard](http://www2.informatik.uni-freiburg.de/~burgard) #### CALVIN won the 2022 IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L) Best Paper Award! We present **CALVIN** (**C**omposing **A**ctions from **L**anguage and **Vi**sio**n**), an open-source simulated benchmark to learn long-horizon language-conditioned tasks. Our aim is to make it possible to develop agents that can solve many robotic manipulation tasks over a long horizon, from onboard sensors, and specified only via human language. CALVIN tasks are more complex in terms of sequence length, action space, and language than existing vision-and-language task datasets and supports flexible specification of sensor suites. # :computer: Quick Start To begin, clone this repository locally Install requirements: If you encounter problems installing pyhash, you might have to downgrade setuptools to a version below 58. Download dataset (choose which split you want to download with the argument `D`, `ABC` or `ABCD`): \ If you want to get started without downloading the whole dataset, use the argument `debug` to download a small debug dataset (1.3 GB). ## :weight_lifting_man: Train Baseline Agent Train baseline models: The `vision_lang_shm` option loads the CALVIN dataset into shared memory at the beginning of the training, speeding up the data loading during training. >[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出 CALVIN 开源模拟基准，在仿真的多房间家庭环境中，通过自然语言指定任务，结合机载传感器输入，支持长时程多任务操作学习并允许灵活配置传感器套件。


# 一、动机

> 现有机器人操作任务数据集缺乏面向长时程、语言条件策略学习的基准，且任务序列长度、动作空间和语言复杂度不足，难以支撑真实场景中由人类语言指定的复杂操作任务研究。


# 二、方法

> 提出 CALVIN 开源模拟基准，在仿真的多房间家庭环境中，通过自然语言指定任务，结合机载传感器输入，支持长时程多任务操作学习并允许灵活配置传感器套件。


# 三、核心实验结果

> CALVIN 获得 2022 RA-L 最佳论文奖；提供 D/ABC/ABCD 多种数据拆分，其中 debug 数据约为 1.3GB，任务序列长度、动作空间和语言复杂度均高于现有视觉语言任务数据集。


# 四、对我的启发

> 该基准对于机器人/具身智能中的长期语言条件操作研究直接相关。启发是：语言-动作对齐需要覆盖更长任务序列和复杂指令，测试不同传感器配置有助于评估视觉-语言模型的鲁棒性。
